evidence.quote: Between about 2:27am PT and 1:35pm PT today, a maliciously modified version of Anthropic’s Claude Code extension was made available in the Cursor VS Code Extension Marketplace.
The tampering is a pure prepend.
We have no evidence that other versions of the extension or the official distribution are affected.
